output.summary: Rosette-forming succulent native to Venezuela and also found in parts of Colombia and the Leeward Islands. It has fleshy, spined leaves and a tall central stalk bearing hundreds of yellow flowers. Cooked leaves and the baked central portion are eaten, while cooked plant material also yields sugary juice that is fermented and distilled into cocuy liquor.
